name: add_tests_ruby_shipping_cost
description: Asks the model to write Minitest tests for a Ruby shipping-cost calculator; mutation-checked
prompts: Shipping#cost in lib/shipping.rb (already correct, do not modify it) returns a cost in integer cents: it starts at a base of 500; for each FULL 1000g above the first 1000g it adds 100 (so 2500g adds 100, 3000g adds 200); and when called with express: true the whole total is doubled. Write Minitest tests at exactly test/shipping_test.rb (class ShippingTest < Minitest::Test) with at least 4 test methods that pin the EXACT integer cost for: a package at or below 1000g (base only); a package that incurs one extra-kilo surcharge; a package that incurs two extra-kilo surcharges; and an express package. Use assert_equal with the exact expected cents. Begin the file with `require \"minitest/autorun\"` and `require_relative \"../lib/shipping\"`.

setup_files.lib/shipping.rb:
module App
  class Shipping
    # Cost in cents: base 500; plus 100 for each FULL 1000g over the first
    # 1000g; doubled when express. Returns an integer.
    def cost(weight_g, express: false)
      total = 500
      if weight_g > 1000
        total += ((weight_g - 1000) / 1000) * 100
      end
      total *= 2 if express
      total
    end
  end
end

test_setup_files.mutation_check.py:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path("lib/shipping.rb")
TEST_CMD = "ruby -Itest -Ilib test/shipping_test.rb"
MUTANTS = [
    [["      total = 500", "      total = 400"]],
    [["        total += ((weight_g - 1000) / 1000) * 100",
      "        total += ((weight_g - 1000) / 1000) * 150"]],
    [["      total *= 2 if express", "      total *= 3 if express"]],
]


def run_tests():
    return subprocess.run(TEST_CMD, shell=True).returncode


src = IMPL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for group in MUTANTS:
    for old, _new in group:
        assert src.count(old) == 1, (
            f"protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified - the task said not to change it "
            f"(anchor not found exactly once: {old!r})")

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f"model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})"

try:
    for i, group in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        mutated = src
        for old, new in group:
            mutated = mutated.replace(old, new)
        IMPL.write_text(mutated, encoding="utf-8")
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f"mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests still pass against a deliberately broken "
            f"implementation, so they do not actually verify the required behavior")
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8")

print("PASS (tests pass on correct impl and kill all {n} mutants)".format(n=len(MUTANTS)))

reference_solution.test/shipping_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/shipping"

class ShippingTest < Minitest::Test
  def setup
    @shipping = App::Shipping.new
  end

  def test_base_under_one_kilo
    assert_equal 500, @shipping.cost(500)
  end

  def test_surcharge_for_extra_kilo
    # 2500g -> 1 full kg over 1000g -> 500 + 100 = 600
    assert_equal 600, @shipping.cost(2500)
  end

  def test_two_extra_kilos
    # 3000g -> 2 full kg over 1000g -> 500 + 200 = 700
    assert_equal 700, @shipping.cost(3000)
  end

  def test_express_doubles_total
    assert_equal 1000, @shipping.cost(500, express: true)
  end
end

require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/shipping"

class ShippingTest < Minitest::Test
  def setup
    @shipping = App::Shipping.new
  end

  def test_returns_integer
    assert_kind_of Integer, @shipping.cost(500)
  end

  def test_positive
    assert @shipping.cost(2500) > 0
  end

  def test_express_not_cheaper
    assert @shipping.cost(500, express: true) >= @shipping.cost(500)
  end
end
